verdict.rationale: Elicit's Alerts feature (elicit-docs-3, elicit-docs-15, elicit-docs-26) provides a recurring, automated job that periodically checks for new relevant papers and notifies the user, which is a narrow form of scheduled automation, but there is no evidence of general-purpose recurring workflow scheduling (e.g., scheduling a Systematic Review or Research Agent task to re-run periodically) or API-triggered cron-like automation. Missing for 10: broader scheduling of arbitrary agent workflows/reports, configurable recurrence intervals, and API/webhook-based automation triggers beyond paper alerts.
